title: Batch conversation-marker anchor resolution in one SQLite snapshot
outcome: Conversation marker anchor resolution opens a separate SQLite connection for each anchor. Marker operations with multiple anchors therefore pay repeated connection and snapshot setup costs and can observe anchors from different database snapshots.
acceptance: Resolve all anchors for one marker operation through one bounded read transaction or equivalent shared snapshot. Add coverage proving multiple anchors use consistent persisted positions and do not require per-anchor database connections.
disposal_reason: NOT PLANNED (backlog triage w-930e4d333f07, 2026-10-05; Greg's approval via Engram::Advisor #293). P3/P4, never started, no holder or children, untouched since before 2026-09-21, not reliability, data safety or pilot. The record is kept; reopen or re-file if it becomes relevant.
